title: Coast Guard, Partner Agencies Rescue 5 From Capsized Boat Off Carolina Beach, NC
description: A MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Elizabeth City hoists three men Saturday, Oct. 19, 2016, from the waters off Carolina Beach, North Carolina. Coast Guard and partner agencies rescued five people from a boat 3 miles from Carolina Beach and close to shore after their boat capsized. Three people stayed near the 20-foot vessel while two swam for shore. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petter Officer 3rd Class Joshua L. Canup.
keywords: kure, SAR, search and rescue, beach, USCG, North, carolina
pass_reason: Dim green-cast hoist cam over dark water; similar capsized-boat story to the Masonboro Short being written now.
